task_spec.refined_instruction: The objective is to clear the table surface by relocating loose objects to available zones. First, pick up the yellow_cube from its current floating position and place it into the cyan_zone, as this is the only unoccupied zone. The blue_book is already situated on the purple_zone, which is a valid location, so it should remain undisturbed. Success is achieved when the yellow_cube is securely placed in the cyan_zone and the table surface (excluding the purple_zone where the book resides) is free of loose objects.
